verdict.rationale: Twenty's documented workflows fire on record changes, schedules, manual actions or incoming webhooks. They chain actions such as record operations, email, HTTP requests, custom JavaScript code, branches, iterators, delays and AI Agent steps. Custom objects also get workflow triggers, and outbound webhooks fire on record create, update and delete, so event-driven rule automation is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the workflow triggers work reliably in practice.
